publisher: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security
source_title: Department of Commerce Closes Export Controls Loophole for Foreign-Owned Semiconductor Fabs in China
claim_relevant_visible_text: Former VEU participants will have 120 days following publication of the rule in the Federal Register to apply for and obtain export licenses. Going forward, BIS intends to grant export license applications to allow former VEU participants to operate their existing fabs in China. However, BIS does not intend to grant licenses to expand capacity or upgrade technology at fabs in China.
researcher_paraphrase: BIS's 2025 VEU revocation explicitly separated continued operation of existing China fabs from future capacity expansion or technology upgrades, the exact distinction MS-0115 is meant to preserve.
precision_guard: This is a later policy state known in 2025. It must not be backdated into 2022-2024 replay, and it does not quantify the resulting wafer or bit-supply effect.
authority_boundary: BIS is authoritative for the announced post-VEU licensing policy and its stated intent.
